## About
Buck's Tavern is a locals bar on Nellis Blvd, on the NE corner of Washington and Nellis. Our motto is simple: where you're only a stranger once.
Kim the owner and the crew behind the bar, like Chikis, Misty and Aidee, are a big part of why people come back. One reviewer said walking in feels like an episode of Cheers. Another, new to Vegas, said people here made them feel like family.
Come for the food and drinks, stay for karaoke and free comedy. We're rated 4.6 from 763 Google reviews, and we'd love to see you in here.

## Services
- Food & Drink: Bar and grill food with drinks to match. One reviewer is coming back just for the steak fries, and another said the staff was understanding of their allergies.
- Karaoke: Grab the mic on karaoke night. One reviewer called it the cherry on top of their night during happy hour.
- Free comedy: Free comedy at the tavern, a favorite with regulars.
- Buck's Free Drink Coupon: Fill out the form on our site and we'll email you a free drink coupon.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open 24 hours, every day of the week.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 1204 N Nellis Blvd, on the NE corner of Washington and Nellis.

Q: How do I get a drink coupon?
A: Fill out the form on our website and we'll email it to you. Limit one coupon per customer per shift.
